fac7bdc7-c1f3-4595-82f5-b5bfb002b933.title: Risou no Himo Seikatsu
fac7bdc7-c1f3-4595-82f5-b5bfb002b933.description: One day, average salaryman Yamai Zenjirou has an out-of-this-world experience—literally! He's pulled from Earth and dragged to another world where magic thrives and a gorgeous, powerful queen needs a consort. Now he's being pressured to marry that very monarch and help her bear a child. Will Zenjirou accept this life of lazy, luxurious love at the cost of leaving his home behind?

chapters.title: The one who rules the world
"I'm not Sure If it's true or not"

748d2aab-cea8-4ffb-89b3-e716872cb027.title: Negatte mo Nai Tsuihou Go kara no Slow Life? ~Intai Shita Hazu ga Nariyuki de Bishoujo Gyaru no Shishou ni Nattara Naze ka Mechakucha Natsukareta~
748d2aab-cea8-4ffb-89b3-e716872cb027.altTitle: An Unexpected Exile and the Slow Life that Followed?: I was Supposed to Retire, But Somehow I Became the Mentor of a Beautiful Gyaru and for Some Reason She's Really Attached to Me
748d2aab-cea8-4ffb-89b3-e716872cb027.description:
Reito Harukaze, yang telah naik hingga ranking tertinggi adventurer, telah pensiun. Saat ia berniat untuk hidup santai dan pensiun, suatu hari seorang gadis gal cantik bernama Karen Hiiragi muncul di hadapannya.

"Hey, onii-san, traktir makan dong!"

Mendengar bahwa Karen kesulitan uang, Reito memutuskan untuk memberinya pelatihan dasar tentang cara menaklukkan dungeon.

"Berkatmu, aku berhasil menyelesaikan dungeon pertamaku! Sensei!"

Padahal sebenarnya ia ingin pensiun dan menikmati hidup santai…

chapters.title: A New Life for Master and Disciple

7af7cbd5-6c77-4c9e-9163-7f01dd6e1cc6.title: Maou Gun Saikyou no Majutsushi wa Ningen datta
7af7cbd5-6c77-4c9e-9163-7f01dd6e1cc6.altTitle: The Strongest Magician in the Demon Lord's Army Was a Human
7af7cbd5-6c77-4c9e-9163-7f01dd6e1cc6.description: "Maou Army's strongest magician" I'm called. Ike, a demon capable of capturing a fort alone. Clearing away enemies with immense magic, he is without a doubt a monster held in awe by friend and foe. However he has a secret he can't tell other demons. "I, actually am a human you know." Using modern knowledge to keep his secret, he became treated as a great commander and the driving force of the Maou's army.

e618f14a-58c0-448c-9eb7-ef30d2422f6f.title: Not-Sew-Wicked Stepmom
e618f14a-58c0-448c-9eb7-ef30d2422f6f.description:
Fairytale stepmothers are notoriously wicked. But after a children’s clothing designer is reborn as young Princess Blanche’s stepmom, she’s determined to break the mold and shower her daughter with love. Now she just has to convince the girl’s cold-hearted father to do the same. In her quest to make a happier home for Blanche, Abigail begins to uncover secrets and schemes within the palace. Will devious forces tear the Freidkins apart, or can Abigail stitch them back into a family?

df7713a7-f8da-4c0f-86e4-a0ec5e251486.description:
Wahhahman is a special robot soldier built ten thousand years ago by the Atlanteans. Found and dug up in present-day Tokyo, 
he doesn't remember anything about his mission or targets due to a nasty knock to the head he received at some point.

chapters.title: Operation: Save Wahhaman Part 4 (Atmospheric Entry Arc)
Close Encounters of the Third Kind

ce38d40c-3b33-4d26-ad15-af93a9425ced.title: Densetsu no Yankee wa Elite Salaryman!?
ce38d40c-3b33-4d26-ad15-af93a9425ced.altTitle: 伝説のヤンキーはエリートサラリーマン!?
ce38d40c-3b33-4d26-ad15-af93a9425ced.description:
"Please make me your disciple!!!"

Souta, who was about to graduate from high school, felt frustrated that he hadn't become the kind of ideal delinquent he had always imagined. 

On his way home one day, a lame-looking office worker with a neatly parted hairstyle and glasses who had gotten into trouble with Souta's delinquent friends ended up completely defeating them! 

To his shock, that office worker turned out to be Morohoshi Keigo, the legendary delinquent Souta had always admired! 

From that day on, Souta starts visiting Morohoshi whenever he has free time, determined to become his apprentice.

Why did he quit being a delinquent? Why is he pretending to be such a lame office worker? As Souta finds himself constantly thinking about Morohoshi, his feelings begin to change in an unexpected way...?!

dcd728f8-4617-428c-bb86-16edc5e7b0de.title: Crowning a Spoiled Prince
dcd728f8-4617-428c-bb86-16edc5e7b0de.altTitle: The Older Sister of a Maniac
dcd728f8-4617-428c-bb86-16edc5e7b0de.description: Legina mengambil alih takhta menggantikan adiknya setelah ayahnya, sang kaisar, dibunuh. Ia melewati semua kesulitan urusan negara, namun beredar kabar bahwa keuangan negara habis karena ulah penurut adiknya dan tunangannya berselingkuh. Akhirnya Legina kehilangan segalanya karena pengkhianatan tunangannya. Di saat terakhir, ia memutar waktu kembali menggunakan peninggalan kaisar pertama. Ia menyatakan akan menjadi pembuat onar yang lebih parah dari adiknya untuk menghentikan kedua orang itu.

ac743453-99ef-49e5-93e5-265cfff01fe0.description: Our protagonist, the speedrunning emperor of *Another Verse*, suddenly feels sleepy in the middle of practice. When he awakens, the familiar opening of *Another Verse* is playing right before his eyes!? In this godly environment where his body is moving better than usual, he has to speedrun! Clear the game world faster than anyone!

f809955a-2059-4a1b-bf8d-4ec0199697bb.title: Inspector Kurokochi
f809955a-2059-4a1b-bf8d-4ec0199697bb.description:
At the Kanagawa police precinct, Inspector Keita Kurokochi is a textbook dirty cop. Having a position at the second division of the precinct tasked with investigating organized and white-collar crimes, Kurokochi knows every local politician's little secrets and their bribes allow him to live in luxury. On the contrary, Chief Inspector Shingo Seike is a naïve newcomer at the precinct full of idealism.   
  
One day, the commissioner of the Kanagawa police force decides to partner Kurokochi with Seike in an effort to finally get rid of the former and stop him from tarnishing the honour of the police force.  
  
The manga was completed in May 2018 with 23 volumes.
